note: The one sentence a harsh letter adds, and nothing else about the letter changes. Keyed by tone, so the same flag reads as velvet from a pleased PC and as a threat from an annoyed one - harsh is the second axis and not a sixth tone, which is what makes five tones times harsh-or-not into ten registers. Prose, so the folder carries the language and a second language is a copied folder where only these strings change. The pleased and annoyed lines are the Author's, from the ticket.
prompt: And whether to lean on him
yes: and let him know the Crown is in earnest

by_tone.pleased: Please see to this matter most promptly, lest we allow room for unpleasantness.
by_tone.dutiful: I shall expect it done, and I shall expect to be told when it is.
by_tone.annoyed: Failure to meet this requirement will be met with most dire consequences.
by_tone.desperate: I have no other course left me, and you would not care for the one I should be driven to.
by_tone.hateful: You will do it, or you will answer for not having done it. I am indifferent as to which.

default: I shall expect it done, and I shall expect to be told when it is.
